methodology.scope: Reviewed posts associated with the four named campaigns on the two requested public profile feeds. Not an exhaustive hashtag or web-wide campaign census.
methodology.metrics: Top-level counters only. Hidden/missing values are null. Plays and views remain separate. Carousel children are not extra posts.
methodology.legacy: The previous 32-project snapshot and original reference associations are preserved. The Love & Hustle follow-through section has its own current scan, rather than rewriting the earlier case counters.
methodology.assets: Source frames resized proportionally to at most 960 pixels and encoded as WebP for website delivery; no generated photography or fabricated reporting.
methodology.role_scope: New role summaries use the user-requested campaign association and the established Ardiles brand/campaign coordination responsibilities; no new ownership of sales, production, budget, or attendance is inferred.

campaigns.title: Speedy Weeedy × Kevinswork: Love & Hustle
campaigns.description: The collaboration continued from the August product release into creator styling, product storytelling, and the Love & Hustle Streetball Showdown at KYZN Kuningan on 17 October 2026.

campaigns.title: Runergize Black White campaign
campaigns.description: A campaign for the Runergize Black White colorway, connecting performance storytelling, athlete content, and the August product release.
campaigns.cover_alt: Runergize campaign film frame featuring an athlete and the Runergize wordmark
details: A product campaign for the Black White edition of Runergize, using the Always Fast message across launch films, product details, athlete content, and partner communication.
Brand communication and campaign-content coordination within the Ardiles Running team.

The public posts show teasers for the 25 August exclusive web release, product and technology content, the 31 August marketplace release, and the Runergize Showdown retailer-content competition in September.

campaigns.title: Drive Day Walker campaign
campaigns.description: Everyday movement, from work to an easy run, brought together in the Drive Day Walker product campaign.
campaigns.outcome: Comfort to walk. Easy to run.
campaigns.cover_alt: Drive Day Walker campaign film showing work and everyday movement in a split-screen scene
details: A campaign presenting Drive Day Walker as a shoe for daily movement, work, casual outfits, and easy running.
Product messaging and campaign-content coordination within the Ardiles Running team.
The October content sequence combines a product introduction, work-to-hangout styling, everyday-use stories, and creator posts around the Comfort to walk, easy to run message.

campaigns.title: Run Into the Wild event activation
campaigns.description: A team-running challenge connecting city activations with a savanna running experience in Banyuwangi.
campaigns.cover_alt: Run Into the Wild participant handing a relay baton to a teammate at the Surabaya activation
details: A community activation built around team racing and the opportunity for winning teams to join a running experience in the Banyuwangi savanna.
Event communication and campaign-content coordination within the Ardiles Running team.
The posts document the 27 September Malang invitation, the 10 October Surabaya activation, participant stories and winner recaps, and the Banyuwangi experience shared at the end of October.
